highlights_headline: The next SkiaSharp 4.156.2 update improves mask-filtered glyph rendering when successive font-scaler loads disagree.

bullets.lead: Handle changing glyph paths and mask layouts
bullets.detail: Mask-filtered glyph rendering uses the reloaded glyph's path rather than a stale outline. Incompatible mask formats are rejected before copying, avoiding sub-byte buffer overwrites, while clipped embossed glyphs preserve full plane strides to prevent corrupted or uncleared mask planes.
